title: IP RAPID role-scoped joined application view (prefix pilot)
selection_rationale: Party involvement in IP applications, with ABNs where supplied; deliberately includes different party types and roles.
notes: One anchor party-activity record per row. Columns are prefixed with the original table name. Model-proposed joins were checked on full right tables; missing/ambiguous matches are null. Do not infer legal business identity, beneficial ownership or enforceability from party role. This is a patent-prefix cohort, not a population sample. Original row/snapshot lineage is in the join experiment. Application status, dates and descriptions apply to the application, not to the business.
